label: Favouring the better as such is a pure perfection
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the good-generality determination (favouring the better as such, not one fixed end content) is a pure perfection: an actuality involving no potency, limitation or reception (DEF-PURE-PERFECTION). It uses the same purity parameter as the #2153 premises, so no sense passage is involved. The Lean type is only Pure goodGen for one token; its content enters through the one-favouring realization bridge.
